The search API is documented. Retrieve every page of matching notes and obtain their IDs so the note contents can be fetched correctly.

```python
tarantino_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=simple_note_access_token,
        query='Quentin Tarantino',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    tarantino_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(tarantino_notes)
```
